name: instrument
description: The NCode design system's tokens, fonts and marks, as a documentation site needs them.
source: A draft of the NCode design system's Instrument direction, taken on 2026-11-15 before any repository held it, so no commit names it: the SHA-256 of each file below records what was taken. tokens.css, fonts.css and fonts/ are the draft's files; logos/ holds its three marks in their blue variants, renamed. The fonts are from @fontsource-variable/instrument-sans and @fontsource-variable/martian-mono 5.3.0, as fonts.css says. The favicons in public/ are from the logo kit in NCodeGroup/project-template at 706a905 (brand/favicon). To be replaced by the design system's first release from NCodeGroup/brand.
